assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All spatial boundaries (site_boundary, key_areas) are provisional and derived from text descriptions in the official announcement. They must be replaced with official polygons when available.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations, land use partitions, and metrics are approximate and must be recalculated when official boundaries are released.

assumptions.statement: Youth demographic estimates are based on publicly available Haidian District statistical data. Precise numbers require access to detailed census and university enrollment data.
assumptions.impact: Youth population projections and service demand estimates should be validated with official demographic data during professional deepening.

assumptions.statement: Global case study analyses (Silicon Valley, Shenzhen, London Tech City, Station F, Zhongguancun) are based on publicly available research and may not reflect the most recent developments.
assumptions.impact: Case study insights should be treated as directional references, not as directly transferable models. Local adaptation requires professional urban design expertise.

assumptions.statement: Existing building stock data (footprints, heights, ages, uses, structural conditions) is not available in the public site package. Building proposals are conceptual only.
assumptions.impact: All building-scale proposals (youth maker spaces, hackathon centers, night code cafes) are conceptual suggestions. They require existing building surveys before any renovation or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: Municipal infrastructure data (water, power, drainage, gas, telecom, district cooling/heating) is not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals for compute clusters, distributed energy, and smart city systems are conceptual only and require detailed engineering assessment.
